programme.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programme.desc: Officers suspect there are a few illegal stowaways hiding amongst a large tour group but the big challenge is to work out who they are. There is a very unpleasant surprise in this shipment from Egypt. A man has arrived with some large wooden statues and officers take drastic steps after they get positive drug tests.

programme.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programme.desc: Officers find some suspicious equipment hidden in the bags of a man travelling with his mother. An American woman says she is here to tie up some loose ends of a failed relationship but a mystery man turns up to meet her at the airport and drops a bomb shell. Narrated by GRANT BOWLER.

programme.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programme.desc: A woman has a major meltdown when officers find a big problem with her handbag. An elderly New Zealand traveller with a criminal record says he's turned over a new leaf but could his past still stop him from attending an important event. Then, when a box of cereal is found with suspicious contents, it might not be the best way to start the day. Narrated by GRANT BOWLER.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.sub-title: The Tale Of The King Of The Woods
programme.desc: When Benjamin falls into Mr Tod's clutches, Peter and Lily lure the fox out of his lair with the promise that he will be crowned 'King Of The Woods'!

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Romeo challenges Carly and Cartoka to a race, but it's all part of a sneaky plan to steal speed crystals.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. But the stones are very big, and it will take more than Mojo's crane top to move them!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno decides to give up napping, but then she has a cranky melt-down! Can Vida convince her to nap?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's time for a Squirrel Clubhouse Spring Clean. Duggee is dusting when the doorbell goes and a big package arrives for him. What is it? Duggee has bought an amazing new hoover, but yikes! It's very powerful.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: It's a lovely sunny day, so Peppa and her family go to the beach, where they learn all about clouds.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Peas meet the stinky Onion-Rexes who help stop the nasty Bananaraptors.

programme.title: It's Andrew!
programme.desc: When Andrew and Gregasus find a mysterious footprint on the ground, Dasha leads them on a quest to find the elusive creature that made it.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: Really Real Rescues visits Kangaroo Beach to film a TV special about the cadets, but trying to look cool on camera lands them in hot water.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.sub-title: The Octonauts And The Giant Kelp Forest
programme.desc: When Kwazii's favourite sub, the Gup-B goes missing, the Octonauts journey into a mysterious kelp forest to find it, meeting strange and interesting creatures along the way.

programme.title: Thomas and Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: When the engines are delivering attractions to the annual Harwick Beach Carnival, a series of mistakes causes the precious Calliope to break. Luckily, the engines come up with a creative solution.

programme.title: Play School: Down At The Beach
programme.desc: Alex and Emma are joined by special guest wildlife scientist Dr. Vanessa who shows us her special diving equipment! Humpty and Little Ted discover sea turtle eggs in the sand and collect rubbish from the beach.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: At a picnic on Annie's farm, Peter comes up with a series of games that almost lead to disaster! Meanwhile, Lizzie and Jodie search for a rare seal.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Miffy is invited over at Ko's for their first playdate. They're excited to play together but have trouble finding something they both like to do - and can do at the same time.

programme.title: The Woohoos!
programme.desc: Iggy thinks his caterpillar friend has disappeared. The Woohoos work out that caterpillars turn into butterflies.

programme.title: Nikhil and Jay
programme.sub-title: Nikhil and Jay and the Supervillain
